"""Main reviewed cache helpers; run finite serialized qualification steps only."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
H = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-helpers-source-v2'
P = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-controller-source-v1'
Q = B / 'latest-update-main-admission-prepare-root-v5/resolved/qualification.json'
Q_SHA = '67071a223d2ea5784366ae9f42b77e0984c8cfda3119c5c9af8a4e16a5da0c6f'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(path))


def main():
    assert sha(Q) == Q_SHA
    assert sha(H / 'manifest.json') == 'cf483e3c0d19012705409a8c5ef469b963ffa86b6e4104ae5515f1fbbef3580c'
    assert sha(H / 'source-pins.json') == 'c0d16780a1b4cea87e96517e3f2e8b2c1defdbbd83202c3786196007c718c7b4'
    manifest = json.loads((H / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    assert {p.name for p in H.glob('*.py')} == set(manifest['files'])
    assert all(sha(H / name) == digest for name, digest in manifest['files'].items())
    sys.path.insert(0, str(H))
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(passed=False, complete=False, active=True, main_reviewed=True,
             source=pin(Path(__file__)), helpers=pin(H / 'manifest.json'),
             model_launch_attempted=False, stages=[], wall_seconds=1200)
    begin = time.monotonic()
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    def step(name, args, root):
        assert time.monotonic() - begin < 780
        sys.argv = [str(H / name), '--main-reviewed', *args]
        try:
            runpy.run_path(str(H / name), run_name='__main__')
        except SystemExit as status:
            assert status.code == 0, (name, status.code)
        receipt = root / 'record.json'
        value = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
        r['stages'].append(pin(receipt))
        save()
        assert value['passed'] and value['complete'] and not value['active']
        return value
    save()
    try:
        cpu_root = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-cpu-root-v1'
        step('cpu_step.py', ['--output', str(cpu_root)], cpu_root)
        compile_root = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-compile-root-v1'
        step('property_step.py', ['--mode', 'compile', '--output', str(compile_root),
             '--qualification', str(Q), '--qualification-sha256', Q_SHA], compile_root)
        property_root = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-property-root-v1'
        capacity = step('property_step.py', ['--mode', 'query', '--output', str(property_root),
             '--qualification', str(Q), '--qualification-sha256', Q_SHA,
             '--compile-receipt', str(compile_root / 'record.json'),
             '--compile-receipt-sha256', sha(compile_root / 'record.json')], property_root)
        pins = json.loads((P / 'qualification-cache.pending.json').read_text())['controller_source_pins']
        assert pins == {p.name: sha(p) for p in P.glob('*.py')}
        review_path = out / 'controller-review.json'
        review = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True,
            gpu_executed=False, model_launch_attempted=False, controller_source_pins=pins,
            property_source=pin(P / 'health_caps.cpp'), helper_manifest=pin(H / 'manifest.json'),
            reviewed_by='/root', scope='Main full source review and actual CPU qualification; model fit and timings separate',
            corrections=['Expected negative pending child exit1 preserved', 'Global capacity >= requested block',
                         'Actual CAPS stdout and exact compilation/command/provider bound by resolver'])
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, indent=2) + '\n')
        input_path = out / 'input-manifest.json'
        inputs = dict(main_reviewed=True, base_qualification=pin(Q),
            controller_cpu=pin(cpu_root / 'record.json'), controller_review=pin(review_path),
            capacity_receipt=pin(property_root / 'record.json'))
        input_path.write_text(json.dumps(inputs, indent=2) + '\n')
        admit_root = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-admission-root-v1'
        result = step('resolve_step.py', ['--manifest', str(input_path),
             '--manifest-sha256', sha(input_path), '--output', str(admit_root)], admit_root)
        r.update(qualification=result['qualification'], measured_properties={key: capacity[key]
            for key in ['ze_max_mem_alloc_size', 'sycl_max_mem_alloc_size', 'sycl_global_mem_size',
                        'usm_atomic_host_allocations', 'usm_atomic_shared_allocations']}, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r['active'] = False
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'qualification', 'measured_properties']}))
    return 0 if r['passed'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
